info.name: FutureSushi - BVA Point 4n+1 - REVIEWED
info.description: Reviewed BVA Point suite: 13 cases = 4n+1, n=3 (phone, finalPrice, orderId). Includes payload assertions and corrected account-based authentication.

exec: pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response is JSON', function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test('Response has token', function () { const d=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(d.token || d.accessToken || d.data?.token).to.exist; });
pm.test('Response time < 1000ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); });
const d=pm.response.json(); const token=d.token || d.accessToken || d.data?.token; if(token){ pm.environment.set('admin_token', token); }
